name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia launched 155 drones overnight to 27 Nov, hitting rail and energy in nine regions and cutting power in six
state: Ukraine said Russia launched 155 attack drones overnight to 27 Nov, 110 of them downed; Prime Minister Koretskyi said railway, energy and civilian sites were hit in nine regions, and power was cut in parts of six (Euronews, Ukrinform). Ukrainian officials reported two killed in Nizhyn, one in Izium and one in Kryvyi Rih (Euronews). Sustained mass strikes on energy and rail keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine carries severe risk; follow FCDO travel advice. Strikes on energy can affect regional power supplies through the winter.
rubric_hit: Mass drone strikes on energy and rail across nine regions = significant escalation
